stepNotes.1: Confirmed the single command export, its yargs arguments, and its registration in the production CLI command array.
stepNotes.2: Traced verbose output into the provider model schema and found unredacted arbitrary headers and options as a Medium disclosure concern.
stepNotes.3: Verified instance scoping, discovery completion, provider lookup, eligibility filtering, and per-provider model sorting.
stepNotes.4: Checked stdout/stderr framing and deterministic provider ordering; identified the successful exit status on an unknown provider.
stepNotes.5: Bounded the cost to provider/model sorting plus concurrent discovery loaders, each protected by a ten-second timeout.
stepNotes.6: Confirmed presentation, provider state, selectability, identity branding, and key formatting remain in their respective layers.
stepNotes.7: Inspected early returns, refresh compatibility behavior, error propagation, markers, suppressions, and stale local naming.
stepNotes.8: Matched shared filter and formatter tests to the command and documented the absence of direct command-level regression coverage.
stepNotes.9: Ran two focused Vitest files with 14 passing tests and completed the package typecheck successfully.
